components.name: Round turret/window host
components.function: Need irregular stone/fort-wall returns, cylindrical tower-wall window bands, cone roof seats, stair-to-terrace corners and climbing-rose attachment layout. Source roofs, rose relief, pink masonry and banners already supply detail vocabulary. Pollinators/robins inhabit planted ledges. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: Hollow cylindrical blush-stone band with four identical arched openings at cardinal directions, 1.8 m wide, 6 m apex height, sill 1.2 m above band base. Front source window vocabulary; fourfold repetition and hidden back are proposed for the first fit test. Open ring ends; no cone roof, glazing, floor, vines or unrelated tower attached.
components.attachment_face: Centre of lower ring [0,0,0]; bottom Y=0, upper ring Y=12; external radius 6 m, wall thickness 0.6 m.
components.semantic_front: Exported GLB Y-up, front -Z; floor tile broad decorated face +Y; see handoff for assembly origins.
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
components.dimension_basis: W X depth Z height Y in metres; proposed local fit dimensions, not measured from generated pixels.
components.notes: Four isolated structural groups visible; blush masonry, pale trim, round hollow turret and actual illustrated portal retained. R01 main stair had too many repeated treads. R02 adds a ten-labelled-step perspective; the small plan still has ambiguous tread divisions. Use the K09/handoff contract, not traced pixels, for exact steps. Turret small plan is a window-level schematic, not a verified top-ring projection: the windows terminate below the top ring. All inter-view parity remains unverified. S02 visible arch trim is host dressing; D07 is an optional replacement/additional surround and must not be blindly doubled over it. Actual aperture sizes, wall thickness, terrain supports, colliders and mesh joins require the Function prototype. No model or final layout approval.
